items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: And he had some formidable players on that that he brought out with him from New York: Sol Gubin was the drummer, a marvelous drummer, Bob Tricarico was the saxophone/bassoon specialist, and Joe Soder was the contractor

ctx.x: Exactly. That’s correct. I was really impressed with that. And actually, as I recall Telly Savalas sounded pretty good when he sang on the Carol Burnett Show. He did, you know that deep voice and he sort of talked it a bit too, but I thought he did quite an acceptable job. But there were those who would really have a very poor sense of pitch and would either sing painfully flat or sharp, one or the other. But they were popular enough that they accepted it I guess.
Who were some of your other bandmates that are pretty well known names now?
